notes.title: SURVIVAL MODE
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45516074/50b1aa1d0565e62e06abe3462fa469c984414cce.png[/img]

The [b]filthiest pizzeria[/b] in town is hiring, and [b]YOU [/b]are the lucky new employee! But be warned... this job could lead to death [b](or worse)[/b].

[b][h2]What awaits you in Survival Mode?[/h2][/b] 

🍕 Serve pizzas before customers lose their minds.
🐕 Feed the stray dog before it goes crazy.
🦟 Exterminate swarms of flies with bug spray.
🧼 Mop the filthy floor before disaster strikes.
🚽 Unclog overflowing toilets of pure nightmare fuel.
🥾 And… throw a slipper at the homeless guy before he turns the restaurant floor into his personal bathroom.

[h3]⚡ An endless loop of madness! ⚡[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45516074/a61db1b21eed6411887ef216f92fbf3280c0c1f4.png[/img]
Every task completed adds more time to the countdown, but letting things pile up will lead to [b][h3]GAME OVER![/h3][/b] Plus, customer satisfaction is always at risk – [b]crying kids, barking dogs, slow service… if the stress bar fills up, you’re doomed.[/b]

[b]🏆 Become the best (or worst) employee🏆[/b]

Climb the [b]Steam Leaderboards[/b] and [b]unlock insane skins[/b] with [b]Poop Jewels[/b], which can also be used in Campaign Mode!

⚠️ [b]And remember:[/b] the Poop Killer is always watching. Keep things under control… or pay the price!
